description: A production-ready FastAPI template for building AI agent applications with LangGraph integration. This template provides a robust foundation for building scalable, secure, and maintainable AI agent services.
vibe: Production-grade AI agents built with strict async discipline, structured observability, and zero tolerance for sloppy logging.
highlights: All imports must be at the top of the file — no exceptions.
structlog events must be lowercase_with_underscores and never use f-strings.
Always use tenacity for retries with exponential backoff.
Only cache successful responses; never cache errors.
Every route must have rate limiting decorators and every LLM call must have Langfuse tracing.
assessment: This instruction file enforces a rare level of operational rigor for AI agent templates, treating logging, retries, caching, and tracing as non-negotiable infrastructure rather than afterthoughts. The explicit anti-patterns and '10 Commandments' create a clear contract that prevents common production failures like silent exceptions, blocking I/O, and untraced LLM calls. The result is a template that genuinely lives up to its 'production-ready' claim by baking in observability and resilience from the start.
